title: Held Bed Days the Resident Pays Privately During a Pending Estimate Month
content:
Under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, a pending estimate month leaves out — at no cost — the bed-hold days the resident pays privately, read from the reservation under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations that the month's booked held days belong to.

**Rule.** The first privately paid held day of a pending estimate month, reading the bed-hold reservation the month's booked held days belong to: where that reservation is a hold whose every held day is the resident's own charge (a private-pay hold or a hold during a Medicare skilled stay), its leave start; where it is a Medicaid reserved bed whose private extension has begun, its private hold start; otherwise none (the first day of the next month), since the program pays the reserved days and patient pay is unchanged for them. The days of the month from that first day through the reservation's last held day (through the month's end where the bed is still held) are taken out.

**Q&A.**

*Which holds count as "every held day is the resident's own charge"?* The private-pay holds (Private Pay Hospital Leave Bed Hold, Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold) and the holds during a Medicare skilled stay (Medicare Skilled Stay Hospital Leave Bed Hold, Medicare Skilled Stay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold). From their leave start, the held days in the month are taken out.

*A Medicaid reserved bed whose private extension has begun?* From the private hold start date, through the last held day or the month's end.

*A Medicaid reserved bed with no private extension, or no held day booked for the month?* No day is taken out.

*The leave start was in an earlier month?* The days are counted from the month's first day.

*Hypothetical:* a Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold with leave start on day 17 and last held day on day 19 takes out 3 days; were the bed still held at the month's end of a 30-day month, days 17 to 30, 14 days, would be taken out.
